title: Credit Builder Accounts Late Fee Reduction for Recently Returned Payments
content:
A Credit Builder late fee for a late due date with no more than one debit card payment credited toward it is reduced when payments on the account were returned shortly before the fee is assessed.

## Reduction

- When two or more payments on the account were returned in the 3 whole calendar months before the assessment date (a return dated on the assessment date counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 3 months earlier falls outside them), the fee is multiplied by the two-return share of 0.75.
- When exactly one payment on the account was returned in those 3 months, the fee is multiplied by the one-return share of 0.9.
- When no payment on the account was returned in those 3 months, the fee is not reduced for returned payments (a share of 1.0).

The returns counted are the account's returned-payment entries by their dates, whatever the return code, a chargeback (code CB) included. The assessment date is the date the late fee is charged, today. The share multiplies the fee before it is rounded to the cent.

| Payments returned in the 3 months | Share |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.75 |
| exactly 1 | 0.9 |
| none | no reduction |

## Window boundaries (hypothetical dates)

Assessment date 20 June:

| Return dated | Counted? |
|---|---|
| 20 March | no, the same day of the month 3 months earlier falls outside |
| 21 March | yes |
| 20 June, the assessment date | yes |

An unrounded fee of 4.00 with one return on 21 March becomes 3.60; with returns on 21 March and 5 June it becomes 3.00.
